# Vendored smile-chat public glossary (MIT)

Pinned revision: see `PINNED_REVISION` (must match `data/SOURCES.lock` /
`scripts/build-dictionary.ps1`).

Contents:

- `frontend/public/LICENSE` — nearest MIT license boundary from smile-chat
- `frontend/public/glossaries/ja_part*.json` — Japanese glossary parts used by
  `glossary-import` and `dictc --glossary-dir`

This snapshot replaces CI access to the private
`systemexe-research-and-development/smile-chat` repository. Refresh only by
checking out that revision, copying the paths above, and updating
`PINNED_REVISION` together with `SOURCES.lock`.
